included_members.explanation: Uses an internal absorbent medium to capture and sequester extracted wash water and dissolved soils.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized washing unit where clothes are suspended in a minimal amount of slightly conductive water or a weak electrolyte solution. The chamber incorporates alternating cation and anion exchange membranes. By applying an electric current, charged dirt particles (ions) and dissolved impurities are drawn out of the fabric and across the membranes, leaving cleaner fabric and significantly purified water for near-complete reuse within the closed system.
included_members.abstraction: Electrokinetic contaminant removal from textiles: Use an applied electric field across a conductive medium in contact with fabric to mobilize charged or polar soils and drive them out of fibers toward a separate collection or capture interface, enabling cleaning with only a minimal liquid layer.
included_members.label: Electrokinetic contaminant removal from textiles
included_members.description: Use an applied electric field across a conductive medium in contact with fabric to mobilize charged or polar soils and drive them out of fibers toward a separate collection or capture interface, enabling cleaning with only a minimal liquid layer.
included_members.explanation: Uses electrostatics/electrokinetics to mobilize and capture charged soils.

included_members.idea_text: A garment cleaning chamber that exposes clothes to precisely tuned mechanical vibrations or sonic frequencies. These frequencies are engineered to resonate with the physical bonds between dirt particles and fabric fibers, effectively loosening and detaching dirt without requiring bulk water. The dislodged particles are then collected by a vacuum or filtration system.
included_members.abstraction: Suction-based debris extraction and containment: Use localized airflow/suction to lift and pull loose dry contaminants (lint, hair, dust, dirt) off fabric surfaces and convey them through a flow path into a trap/filter/collection stage, removing debris without relying on water flushing.
included_members.label: Suction-based debris extraction and containment

included_members.explanation: Uses suction-based extraction to lift and contain dry contaminants without water.

included_members.idea_text: A laundry chamber designed to expose garments to a very thin, fabric-safe, conductive liquid film (e.g., minimal water with a mild electrolyte). An oscillating electric field is applied across the fabric. Dirt and oil particles, which often carry a net electrical charge, are made to migrate through the liquid film towards specialized collector electrodes or a permeable membrane, effectively "scavenging" them off the fabric with significantly less water and no mechanical scrubbing.

included_members.abstraction: Permeable contaminant capture interface: Place a dedicated, permeable collection structure in the wash flow path that receives soils mobilized from fabric and physically retains or separates them, routing the extracted contaminants away for processing or disposal so they don’t redeposit while using minimal water.
included_members.label: Permeable contaminant capture interface
included_members.description: Place a dedicated, permeable collection structure in the wash flow path that receives soils mobilized from fabric and physically retains or separates them, routing the extracted contaminants away for processing or disposal so they don’t redeposit while using minimal water.
included_members.explanation: Involves a dedicated permeable collection structure to physically retain and separate mobilized soils from the fabric.

included_members.idea_text: A handheld device or an automated robotic system with a specialized roller or pad whose surface mimics the micro- or nano-structure of gecko feet. This roller would be gently passed over garments, picking up dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial grime through contact. The collected dirt would then be released from the roller's surface into a waste receptacle (e.g., by a slight change in angle or pressure), allowing the cleaning surface to be reused repeatedly without water or chemicals.
included_members.abstraction: Controlled mechanical contact transport for contaminant pickup and removal: A mechanism that moves garments and a pickup surface through a managed contact path—controlling pressure, relative motion, and exposure of fresh surface area—to transfer soils from fabric, then conveys the collected debris to a discharge point for disposal/regeneration.
included_members.label: Controlled mechanical contact transport for contaminant pickup and removal
included_members.description: A mechanism that moves garments and a pickup surface through a managed contact path—controlling pressure, relative motion, and exposure of fresh surface area—to transfer soils from fabric, then conveys the collected debris to a discharge point for disposal/regeneration.
included_members.explanation: Utilizes mechanical contact with a pickup surface (solid media) to transfer and remove soils from the fabric.

The collected dirt would then be released from the roller's surface into a waste receptacle (e.g., by a slight change in angle or pressure), allowing the cleaning surface to be reused repeatedly without water or chemicals.

included_members.abstraction: Dry particulate adhesion capture surface: Use a textured pickup interface that physically adheres to and retains dry debris (lint, dust, hair) through high-surface-area contact and mechanical/adhesive forces, enabling cleaning without relying on water-based rinsing.

included_members.description: Use a textured pickup interface that physically adheres to and retains dry debris (lint, dust, hair) through high-surface-area contact and mechanical/adhesive forces, enabling cleaning without relying on water-based rinsing.
included_members.explanation: Employs an adhesive, high-surface-area interface to capture dry debris without using water.

included_members.idea_text: Develop garments or specialized fabric liners with embedded or woven piezoelectric fibers. When these garments are placed in a dry tumbling drum, the gentle mechanical motion of tumbling induces micro-vibrations within the fabric itself (due to the piezoelectric effect). These self-generated, high-frequency vibrations effectively loosen and dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles from the fibers, which are then collected by an integrated vacuum and filter system within the drum, eliminating the need for water for general refreshing.
included_members.abstraction: In-drum airflow-based particle capture: Use an internal air-circulation pathway coupled with filtration inside the drum to entrain loosened soil and fibers and separate them from the textiles, retaining contaminants without relying on large water volumes.
included_members.label: In-drum airflow-based particle capture
included_members.description: Use an internal air-circulation pathway coupled with filtration inside the drum to entrain loosened soil and fibers and separate them from the textiles, retaining contaminants without relying on large water volumes.
included_members.explanation: Relies on in-drum airflow and filtration to extract, separate, and retain loosened dirt instead of bulk water rinsing.

included_members.idea_text: A sealed garment cabinet containing regenerable desiccant materials (e.g., advanced zeolites or MOFs) and a fan. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the desiccant bed. The desiccant actively pulls moisture (and dissolved body oils/odors) directly from the fabric into the air stream, and then adsorbs it. This dry extraction process cleanses and deodorizes garments without the use of water. The desiccant can then be heated to release the dirty moisture for disposal and regenerate for reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Chemical-potential-driven extraction into a sink medium: Clean by creating a strong chemical-potential gradient that pulls water and dissolved/volatile soils out of fabric and transfers them into an external “sink” medium (e.g., concentrated phase or sorbent/air stream) that captures the extracted moisture/contaminants, minimizing the need for bulk rinse water.
included_members.label: Chemical-potential-driven extraction into a sink medium
included_members.description: Clean by creating a strong chemical-potential gradient that pulls water and dissolved/volatile soils out of fabric and transfers them into an external “sink” medium (e.g., concentrated phase or sorbent/air stream) that captures the extracted moisture/contaminants, minimizing the need for bulk rinse water.
included_members.explanation: Extracts water and soils into an external sink medium or sorbent instead of relying on bulk rinse water.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized enclosed chamber where garments are suspended and gently agitated by powerful, non-audible ultrasonic standing waves. This contactless "tumbling" and manipulation effectively loosens dry dirt, dust, and lint from the fabric fibers. A gentle filtered airflow simultaneously draws away the dislodged particles into a collection system, providing a dry, contact-free cleaning and refreshing process without any water or mechanical wear on the fabric.
included_members.abstraction: Low-velocity airflow conveyance with filtration capture: Use gentle, continuous or post-actuation airflow to entrain dislodged debris from garments and transport it away from the fabric into a filtration/collection subsystem, replacing water-based flushing while minimizing disturbance to the cleaning zone.
included_members.label: Low-velocity airflow conveyance with filtration capture
included_members.description: Use gentle, continuous or post-actuation airflow to entrain dislodged debris from garments and transport it away from the fabric into a filtration/collection subsystem, replacing water-based flushing while minimizing disturbance to the cleaning zone.
included_members.explanation: Uses airflow to convey and extract loosened debris into a filtration/collection subsystem, acting as suction/capture.

included_members.idea_text: A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.
included_members.abstraction: Capillary wicking contaminant sequestration: Uses a highly wetting, porous absorbent interface to pull moisture and mobilized soils out of fabric via capillary action, then retain/trap that liquid and contaminants within its internal structure to reduce the need for bulk rinse water.
included_members.label: Capillary wicking contaminant sequestration
included_members.description: Uses a highly wetting, porous absorbent interface to pull moisture and mobilized soils out of fabric via capillary action, then retain/trap that liquid and contaminants within its internal structure to reduce the need for bulk rinse water.
included_members.explanation: Using a porous absorbent interface to pull moisture and soils out of fabric via capillary action matches extraction using sorbents and solid media.

included_members.idea_text: A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. The slime is then processed for disposal or regeneration, leaving clean, residue-free clothes with minimal water usage.
included_members.abstraction: Sacrificial contaminant-capturing removable layer: Apply a temporary, fabric-safe coating/film that preferentially binds or encapsulates soils and odors, then remove the layer intact to physically extract the captured contaminants from the textile with minimal water use.
included_members.label: Sacrificial contaminant-capturing removable layer
included_members.description: Apply a temporary, fabric-safe coating/film that preferentially binds or encapsulates soils and odors, then remove the layer intact to physically extract the captured contaminants from the textile with minimal water use.
included_members.explanation: Applying a sacrificial layer that encapsulates soils and is then physically removed exactly fits non-aqueous soil capture via sacrificial layers.

This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. The slime is then processed for disposal or regeneration, leaving clean, residue-free clothes with minimal water usage.
included_members.abstraction: Stimulus-triggered medium release from textiles: A controlled mechanism that, when activated by a chosen stimulus, destabilizes or changes the state/adhesion of an intermediate medium (e.g., coating/film) so it cleanly detaches from the fabric while carrying captured contaminants away, reducing the need for bulk rinse water.
included_members.label: Stimulus-triggered medium release from textiles
included_members.description: A controlled mechanism that, when activated by a chosen stimulus, destabilizes or changes the state/adhesion of an intermediate medium (e.g., coating/film) so it cleanly detaches from the fabric while carrying captured contaminants away, reducing the need for bulk rinse water.
included_members.explanation: Detaching an intermediate medium (coating/film) that carries away captured soils is a non-aqueous, sacrificial layer approach to soil capture.

included_members.idea_text: A garment refresh chamber where clothes are exposed to a specific low-temperature plasma (e.g., derived from oxygen or hydrogen precursor gases). This plasma generates energetic reactive species tuned to gently react with and break down organic residues (body oils, odors, superficial grime) on the fabric surface. These contaminants are converted into volatile byproducts that are then vacuumed away, providing a deep, dry clean at a molecular level without water or harsh chemicals, thereby extending garment life.
included_members.abstraction: Negative-pressure contaminant removal: Use a controlled vacuum/airflow to continuously extract moisture vapor and loosened contaminants from the cleaning zone, preventing them from settling back onto the fabric and reducing the need for water-based rinsing.
included_members.label: Negative-pressure contaminant removal
included_members.description: Use a controlled vacuum/airflow to continuously extract moisture vapor and loosened contaminants from the cleaning zone, preventing them from settling back onto the fabric and reducing the need for water-based rinsing.
included_members.explanation: Using a controlled vacuum and airflow to extract moisture and loosened contaminants fits suction-based extraction.

included_members.idea_text: Garments are exposed to a minimal, fine mist of water and a cleaning agent, just enough to lightly wet the fabric and encapsulate dirt. The wetted garment is then gently frozen (e.g., with chilled air) and placed in a low-pressure chamber. The frozen cleaning solution and dirt sublimate away, removing contaminants directly from the fabric structure without liquid drainage or mechanical stress, resulting in clean, dry clothes with minimal water usage.
included_members.abstraction: Phase-change, low-liquid contaminant immobilization and removal: Use a small amount of fluid only to bind/encapsulate soils, then immobilize the bound contaminants by converting the carrier to a solid phase, and finally remove the solidified carrier (and trapped contaminants) via phase-transition-driven separation under low pressure—achieving cleaning without bulk water flushing.

included_members.description: Use a small amount of fluid only to bind/encapsulate soils, then immobilize the bound contaminants by converting the carrier to a solid phase, and finally remove the solidified carrier (and trapped contaminants) via phase-transition-driven separation under low pressure—achieving cleaning without bulk water flushing.
included_members.explanation: Solidifying a liquid carrier to encapsulate and remove soils aligns with interfacial and non-aqueous soil capture via solid media or sacrificial layers.
